test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

He carries that sorrow with him now, just under the surface, almost __tangible.__
solution: The correct answer is '**Abstract**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Tangible**' is '**Abstract**'. • **Tangible**: that can be clearly seen to exist. (स्पष्‍ट और वास्‍तविक) • *Example: There are **tangible** benefits in the new system.* • **Abstract**: existing only as an idea, not as a physical thing. (विचार या कल्‍पना मात्र में न कि कोई भौतिक वस्‍तु; अमूर्त) • *Example: It is hard to imagine an **abstract** idea like ‘eternity’.*** Correct Answer:__** *Abstract.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Detectable**: able to be discovered or identified. (खोजा या पहचाना जा सकता है) • **Actual**: existing in fact; real. (वास्तव में विद्यमान; वास्तविक।) • **Distinct**: clear; easily seen, heard or understood. (स्‍पष्‍ट; सुव्‍यक्त) 3d:T919, The correct answer is **'is easier than'.**
